column1: # How agentctl treats a RED scheduled/post-landing workflow (agentctl reads this file from main). One row per
# workflow, tab-separated, `#` comments and blank lines ignored:
#   verify_dispatch  yes | no -- may agentctl dispatch the workflow to verify a landed fix (no: it costs money, or
#                    needs a service only the schedule may call; the fix is verified by the next scheduled run)
#   replay           a command template, or `-`. A fixer for a red of this workflow runs it at base (origin/main)
#                    and at head (the fix) BEFORE landing and lands only on base=FAIL head=PASS. `{run}` is replaced
#                    by the red's failing run id. The command ends with a `Fix-Replay: ... base=X head=Y` line.
#   why              what the replay costs / why there is none
# A workflow with no row has no replay and may not be dispatched to verify.
